answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in karst, verified in plume, and kernel names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 41 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 7 hours of verification and 29 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
